title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Gubat District Hospital to Salvador R. Encinas District Hospital in Gubat, Sorsogon
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Gubat District Hospital to Salvador R. Encinas District Hospital in Gubat, Sorsogon
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Bệnh viện huyện Gubat thành Salvador R. Encinas District Hospital in Gubat, Sorsogon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Gubat เป็น Salvador R. Encinas District Hospital in Gubat, Sorsogon
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Rumah Sakit Kabupaten Gubat menjadi Salvador R. Encinas District Hospital in Gubat, Sorsogon
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Hospital Daerah Gubat menjadi Salvador R. Encinas District Hospital in Gubat, Sorsogon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2015/ra_10671_2015.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Change of Hospital Name. – The name of Gubat District Hospital in the Municipality of Gubat, Province of Sorsogon is hereby changed to Salvador R. Encinas District Hospital.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in any newspaper of general circulation.
